content.text: Team news Team news: Odegaard returns to face Man City Share Arsenal Media 19 Apr 2026 Martin Odegaard is back in the starting line-up to face Manchester City in Sunday’s top of the table Premier League clash. The captain returns after missing our last two games through injury, while Kai Havertz is also brought in to start. The two players to drop out from our goalless draw with Sporting on Wednesday are Viktor Gyokeres and Gabriel Martinelli, who are both among the substitutes. It means Eberechi Eze keeps his place, while Noni Madueke has shaken off a knock as well to start on the right wing. David Raya is in goal behind an unchanged back four of Cristhian Mosquera, William Saliba, Gabriel and Piero Hincapie. The hosts are unchanged from the side that beat Chelsea 3-0 last weekend. Read more Preview: Man City v Arsenal LINE-UPS Manchester City: Donnarumma, Nunes, Khusanov, Guehi, O'Reilly, Rodri, Bernardo, Semenyo, Cherki, Doku, Haaland.Substitutes: Trafford, Reijnders, Stones, Ake, Marmoush, Nico, Ait-Nouri, Savinho, Foden. Arsenal: Raya, Mosquera, Saliba, Gabriel, Hincapie, Zubimendi, Rice, Eze, Odegaard, Madueke, Havertz. Substitutes: Arrizabalaga, White, Jesus, Martinelli, Gyokeres, Norgaard, Trossard, Lewis-Skelly, Dowman. Copyright 2026 The Arsenal Football Club Limited.
